children: Noble Corp plc (NE) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026.

On October 26, 2026, Noble Corporation plc (the "Company") issued a press release announcing its condensed consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of such press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 and will be published in the "Investors" section on the Company's website at www.noblecorp.com.
Pursuant to the rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission, the press release is being furnished and shall not be deemed to be "filed" under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000147/ne-20261026.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000147/0001895262-26-000147-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
